note: Day-zero migration plan: old -> new path + sha256 for every tracked file under results/ and every wiki/campaigns/*.md page. Nothing has moved. Unresolved rows need a human ruling before the move-only PR.

layout.mirrored: <cell>/<measurement>.<ext> -- the only slot that may become current
layout.experiment: <cell>/experiments/<name>/<measurement>.<ext> (and job sidecars in <cell>/experiments/) -- arms and experiment scripts; never current
layout.setup_id: <backend>_<device>_<operator>_<precision>[_<transformer>]; the transformer names the likelihood route: sparse interferometric = wtilde
layout.model_variant: path segment only for non-default variants (light_fixed, rtu, mge_mass)
layout.misc: results/misc/<group>/... -- files with no derivable cell; never current
layout.archive: archive/YYYY/MM/<slug>/<path under results/ or inside the pack>; YYYY/MM is the file's own date (name or JSON), else the latest date in its slug, else a citing ledger's date, else archive/undated/<slug>/
